o.text: From Arabic سَوْدَاء (sawdāʔ, “black bile, melancholy”). The meaning shifted to the present ones under the influence of Azerbaijani sevmək, to which it is originally unrelated.

glosses: pinch (a small amount of powder or granules, such that the amount could be held between fingertip and thumb tip.)
shot, gunshot, round (launching of a projectile)

o.text: From Proto-Turkic *at, whence also Azerbaijani atqı (“crossbar”). Cognate with Chuvash ытам (yt̬am, “armful”).
From Borrowed from Russian журналѝстика (žurnalìstika). By surface analysis, jurnalist + -ika
Borrowed from Arabic مَجْبُورًا (majbūran). By surface analysis, məcbur + -ən.
From qulaq + -cıq. Cognate with Turkish kulakçık.
